tok 1.0 "Ultrasound-guided vein puncture"

pool unit "Vascular access unit"
  lane doctor "Doctor"
    start begin "Puncture needed"
    task prepare "Prepare the implements"
    task wash "Wash the hands"
    task gown "Put on sterile clothes"
    task clean "Clean the puncture area"
    task drape "Drape the puncture zone"
    task configure "Configure the ultrasound"
    task gelprobe "Put gel in the probe"
    task cover "Cover the probe"
    task stergel "Put the sterile gel"
    task posprobe "Position the probe"
    task pospat "Position the patient"
    xor vein "Vein identification method?"
    task anat "Identify the vein by anatomic identification"
    task dopp "Identify the vein by doppler identification"
    task comp "Identify the vein by compression identification"
    xor veinok "Vein identified"
    task punct "Anesthetize and puncture the patient"
    task blood "Check the blood return"
    xor bloodok "Blood return correct?"
    task dropp "Drop the probe"
    task syr "Remove the syringe"
    task guide "Install the guidewire"
    task trocar "Remove the trocar"
    xor wiremeth "Wire check method?"
    task longax "Check the wire in the long axis"
    task shortax "Check the wire in the short axis"
    xor wiremerge "Wire checked"
    task wirepos "Check whether the wire is in good position"
    xor goodpos "Wire in good position?"
    task widen "Widen the pathway"
    task advance "Advance the catheter"
    task rmguide "Remove the guidewire"
    task verifyflow "Verify the flow and the reflow"
    task catpos "Check the catheter position"
    end done "Puncture completed"

flow begin -> prepare -> wash -> gown -> clean -> drape -> configure -> gelprobe -> cover -> stergel -> posprobe -> pospat -> vein
flow vein -> anat "anatomic"
flow vein -> dopp "doppler"
flow vein -> comp "compression"
flow anat -> veinok
flow dopp -> veinok
flow comp -> veinok
flow veinok -> punct -> blood -> bloodok
flow bloodok -> punct "no"
flow bloodok -> dropp "yes"
flow dropp -> syr -> guide -> trocar -> wiremeth
flow wiremeth -> longax "long axis"
flow wiremeth -> shortax "short axis"
flow longax -> wiremerge
flow shortax -> wiremerge
flow wiremerge -> wirepos -> goodpos
flow goodpos -> punct "no"
flow goodpos -> widen "yes"
flow widen -> advance -> rmguide -> verifyflow -> catpos -> done
